common.tagline: An Explainable, Rule-Assisted Civic Complaint Platform with GIS Mapping and Citizen-Verified Resolution

auth.loginSubtitle: Access your municipal dashboard, report hazards, and track resolution progress.
auth.demoAccountsHint: For evaluation, click any demo account to auto-fill credentials:
auth.forgotPasswordNotice: Password reset via automated email is not available in this version. In this release of CivicFix, outbound mail services are not configured.
auth.forgotPasswordContact: To recover or reset your account credentials, please contact the system administrator or your municipal administrative authority.
auth.forgotPasswordCitizenNote: Residents: Contact your municipal office or administrator with your registered email address.
auth.forgotPasswordStaffNote: Staff & Technicians: Contact your IT administrator or department supervisor for credential assistance.
auth.errorInvalid: Invalid email or password. Please verify your credentials.
auth.errorUnreachable: Server is unreachable. Please ensure the municipal backend is active.
auth.registerSubtitle: Join CivicFix to submit civic hazards, receive direct status updates, and verify local repairs.
auth.phoneInvalid: Please provide a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.

citizenDashboard.subtitle: Track your civic reports, inspect resolution milestones, and register urban infrastructure issues.
citizenDashboard.activeComplaintsSubtitle: Currently in municipal triage or active repair
citizenDashboard.resolvedComplaintsSubtitle: Verified and closed in your sector
citizenDashboard.noComplaintsSubtitle: Notice a pothole, broken streetlight, or water leak in your neighborhood? Submit your first report.

reportComplaint.subtitle: Submit civic infrastructure hazards for rapid municipal resolution and departmental crew dispatch.
reportComplaint.issueTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Deep asphalt pothole near bus stop
reportComplaint.narrativePlaceholder: Describe the severity, damage to vehicles, traffic impact, or risk to pedestrians...
reportComplaint.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
reportComplaint.photoUploadHint: Upload up to 3 JPEG or PNG photos (max 5MB each). Real on-site photos improve automated triage accuracy.
reportComplaint.addressPlaceholder: Enter street name, landmark, or nearby shop...
reportComplaint.gpsFailed: Could not detect GPS location. You may enter the address manually.
reportComplaint.reviewWarning: Please ensure the defect narrative and location are accurate before sending.
reportComplaint.successMessage: Your report has been logged and queued for municipal officer triage and field inspection.
reportComplaint.validationTitleRequired: Please provide a clear title for the issue.
reportComplaint.validationDescRequired: Please describe the defect in detail.
reportComplaint.visionConsentCheckbox: I agree that my complaint photo may be sent to an external AI service ({{provider}}) to suggest a category. Please make sure no faces or vehicle number plates are visible. This is optional; the complaint works without it.
reportComplaint.webpPhotoNotice: WebP photos are not analyzed. Use JPEG or PNG for photo analysis.

complaints.subtitle: Track real-time municipal response, technician dispatch, and resolution evidence for your reported issues.
complaints.searchPlaceholder: Search by ticket ID, title, or ward...
complaints.emptySubtitle: You have no reports matching the selected filter criteria.
complaints.noEvidence: Repair evidence has not been submitted by the field technician yet.
complaints.citizenConfirmationPrompt: Field work has been completed and verified by the Municipal Officer. Please inspect the site and confirm or dispute the resolution.
complaints.confirmSuccess: Thank you! You have confirmed the resolution. The issue is now closed.
complaints.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Explain why the repair is incomplete, sub-standard, or recurring...
complaints.rejectReasonRequired: Please provide a clear reason for disputing the resolution.

notifications.title: Citizen Notifications & Alerts
notifications.subtitle: Real-time updates regarding your municipal hazard reports and repair milestones.
notifications.emptySubtitle: You are all caught up! Updates about your complaints will appear here.
